module.label: Footage Desk
module.description: Reviews recorded footage in its own application.

flows.label: Recorded footage is opened
flows.detail: Scan, review, CSV and analysis pools omit explicit replay-only producer entries. Review recordings, save clips, extract remaining keepers and finish the recording in separate desk views. User decisions remain in the database. Removal is explicit: server checks current keeper exports and unresolved moments before reversible trash; permanent deletion is separately confirmed and rechecks retained media.

steps.label: Select recording
steps.detail: Only eligible recordings enter automatic review; the replay catalog is read without importing its feature.

steps.label: Review proposed moments
steps.detail: Full-recording highlight, game and saved-clip tracks stay visible. The close-up timeline stays visible. Clicking the overview navigates and centers that viewport without replacing a clip. Clicking the close-up track previews; dragging across it draws a separate custom selection. Handles use a fixed scale throughout a drag. Cursor-anchored wheel zoom, zoom buttons, Shift-drag pan and Fit clip control the view without changing boundaries. Capture ends on release, source/window replacement or page hiding; frame seeks retain only the latest pending source-scoped target while a decoder is seeking. Game snapshots reject obsolete source responses. Selection preview stops at its end. Keep, Extract this clip, Remove clip and single-step Undo use the existing catalogue/media owners; notes and tags remain optional.

steps.label: Keep personal review markers
steps.detail: Existing personal markers are preserved. Resizing a selected saved clip updates that marker with its title, tags and notes. Remove clip changes the marker to not-kept while retaining notes and exported files. Undo restores the prior clip decision and bounds, or unkeeps a newly saved clip; a newer saved edit prevents stale undo. Saved clips lists current exports and cuts needing extraction after a boundary change.

steps.label: Extract remaining keepers
steps.detail: One existing bounded media worker exports all audio tracks with portable source metadata. Pending UI feedback prevents duplicate extraction clicks.

steps.label: Choose what stays
steps.detail: Keep full, keep only clips or mark original for removal are explicit recording decisions; the last choice adds the original to Clear space without deleting it. Unresolved moments and unexported keepers block original removal.

steps.label: Check before original removal
steps.detail: User confirms reversible trash. Permanent deletion is separately confirmed and rechecks retained clips; extraction never automatically removes a source.
